official_contracts.subject: max_test
official_contracts.claim: Self-starting .maxtest.maxpat tests terminate through test.terminate and retain results in SQLite.

official_contracts.subject: sample_accurate_scheduling
official_contracts.claim: Sample-accurate event-to-audio behavior requires Overdrive, Scheduler in Audio Interrupt, a high-priority event, and a supported downstream object.

official_contracts.subject: max_for_live_timing
official_contracts.claim: Unnamed transports in Live devices follow Live; preview-mode transitions may disrupt continuity.

official_contracts.subject: midi_delivery
official_contracts.claim: MIDI output and input objects bind named ports; source-list output alone is not receiving-port evidence.

official_contracts.subject: audio_capture
official_contracts.claim: record~ or sfrecord~ can retain the actual MSP signal rather than a message-domain proxy.

max_test.runner_caveat: At the pinned revision any second argument selects macOS architecture and also suppresses test.rb's explicit process exit; retain the complete console transcript and terminate only the finished Ruby wrapper if it remains alive after printing the database path and summary.

retained_artifacts: raw diagnostics, MIDI capture, timing capture, and PCM render used by residual checks

required_observations: DSP was active before each scripted destruction cycle
all construction and destruction cycles completed
the host terminated normally without crash or hang
the platform diagnostic reported zero invalid accesses and zero definitely lost allocations

scenarios.name: supported_enabled_timely
scenarios.expectation: Every adjacent captured impulse is exactly 2400 samples apart at the baseline sample rate.

scenarios.name: supported_without_siai
scenarios.expectation: Retain observed offsets as a negative control; do not require or claim sample accuracy.

scenarios.name: supported_without_overdrive
scenarios.expectation: Retain observed offsets as a negative control; do not require or claim sample accuracy.

scenarios.name: late_absolute_target
scenarios.expectation: A target at or before the freshly observed transport tick is rejected and produces no callback or impulse.

scenarios.name: ordinary_message_consumer
scenarios.expectation: Retain message-domain timing only; do not promote it to target-to-audio evidence.

required_observations: the exact selected output port name
the exact independently selected input port and receiver name/version
the raw received byte stream in order
no missing, additional, or reordered channel-1 note bytes

residual_checks.format: WAVE float32 or float64 without lossy encoding

objects.measurable_criterion: Every retained settled sample equals -1 within 1e-7.

objects.configuration: attack 0, decay 0, sustain 0.375, release 0, reset, gate 1
objects.measurable_criterion: Every retained settled sample equals 0.375 within 1e-7.
Every retained settled sample equals -0.25 within 1e-7.
Every adjacent retained sample advances by 1/24000 quarter note within 1e-10 at the baseline sample rate.

max_for_live_transport_scenarios.name: stop_start
max_for_live_transport_scenarios.invariant: A pending future event fires at most once after transport resumes; callbacks remain healthy and gauges return to zero.

max_for_live_transport_scenarios.name: seek_forward_and_backward
max_for_live_transport_scenarios.invariant: No fired one-shot is emitted twice and no cancelled/reassigned slot emits stale output across either seek direction.

max_for_live_transport_scenarios.name: arrangement_loop
max_for_live_transport_scenarios.invariant: Crossing the scheduled tick on later loop iterations cannot replay an already consumed one-shot.

max_for_live_transport_scenarios.name: tempo_change
max_for_live_transport_scenarios.invariant: The event remains tied to its ITM tick; observed wall-clock/sample placement is retained without inferring constant-tempo phase.

max_for_live_transport_scenarios.name: preview_enter_exit
max_for_live_transport_scenarios.invariant: Any documented preview discontinuity is retained; after exit the object remains usable, callback health is true, and no stale slot output appears.

max_for_live_transport_scenarios.name: scheduler_settings
max_for_live_transport_scenarios.invariant: Enabled and disabled Overdrive/SIAI observations remain separate and only the fully enabled supported path may claim sample accuracy.

named_live_run.required_result: A non-null strict AbletonValidationRecord from a consumed guarded plan, retained with the complete JSON-RPC transcript, installed server and Remote Script tree digests, and before/after Live log snapshots.
